claims: The Artemis II mission concluded on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission concluded with a successful splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II splashdown occurred at 8:07 p.m. ET.
The Orion capsule landed safely in the water.
A joint NASA and U.S. Navy recovery team extracted the four crew members.
The splashdown location was the Pacific Ocean west of San Diego.
The Artemis II mission was a 10-day crewed lunar flyby mission.
The Artemis II crew was retrieved by Navy helicopters.
The Artemis II crew was brought to a nearby ship.
The Artemis II crew spent 10 days traveling around the Moon.
The Artemis II crew returned to Earth safely.
The Artemis II crew faced extreme heat during reentry
